definition: to try to do something hard
description: In a dusty village square on a sunny afternoon with trees, colourful bunting and a cart with a wooden barrel, a young man in a grey sleeveless top and dark trousers crouches with his legs wide, grips a huge round boulder with both hands and slowly lifts it off the ground in a cloud of dust, his face tight with effort. Two old men with walking sticks sit on chairs and watch closely, other villagers stand behind them and a dog lies in the shade.

taps.target: the old man in the cap

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er versucht, einen riesigen Felsbrocken zu heben.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está intentando levantar una roca enorme.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il essaie de soulever un énorme rocher.
fr.question: Que fait le jeune homme ?
